metadata.description: One Veo ride per feature, drawn through the GPS positions Veo reported about once a minute. `times` are the Unix times of each position; `segment_ids` is the estimated route on the network.
metadata.credit: Ride data: Veo GBFS feed. Paths and roads: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Facilities: Texas A&M Transportation Services, TAMU campus basemap, City of College Station.
